turf.definition:
n. surface layer of ground containing a mat of grass and grass roots
n. the territory claimed by a juvenile gang as its own
n. range of jurisdiction or influence
v. cover (the ground) with a surface layer of grass or grass roots
turf.translation:
n. 草皮, 泥炭, 跑马场
vt. 覆草皮于

turf out.translation: 把…赶出; 丟弃; <俚>抛出（东西）; 赶走（某人）

turf toe.translation: (脚趾伸展过度引起的)草皮脚趾伤

turf war.translation: n. （黑帮之间的）地盘争夺战

turfed.translation:
n. 草皮；泥炭；跑马场
vt. 覆草皮于

turfen.definition: a. Made of turf; covered with turf.
turfen.translation: a. 有草皮的, 覆盖草皮的

turfiness.definition: n. Quality or state of being turfy.

turfing.definition:
p. pr. & vb. n. of Turf
n. The act or process of providing or covering with turf.

turfite.definition:
n. A votary of the turf, or race course; hence, sometimes, a
   blackleg.
turfite.translation: n. 赛马迷, 赛马通

turfman.definition: n. A turfite; a votary of the turf, or race course.

turfmen.translation: n. 赛马迷( turfman的名词复数 )

turfs.translation: n. 草皮( turf的名词复数 ); 泥炭; <非正>地盘; 赛马场

turfski.translation: n. [体]滑草板(一种用于滑草运动、形似雪橇、 底有小轮的套脚滑板)

turfy.definition:
superl. Abounding with turf; made of, or covered with, turf.
superl. Having the nature or appearance of turf.
superl. Of or pertaining to the turf, or horse racing.
turfy.translation: a. 草皮的, 泥炭的, 与赛马有关的
